Game Overview

Radiant Rush puts players into a car experience centered on race down vibrant, neon-lit tracks in Radiant Rush. Master loose car physics as you collect light cubes to keep the pulse-pounding action alive. Balancing on the edge, steer skillfully to avoid turning your high-speed dreams into glowing particles. How far will your luminous journey take you?
